scope: Three fixed native-game cameras with active world, five seconds warmup then four seconds frame sampling per view. Editor executable, hidden stationary rider, no riding/collision/audio or sustained shipping performance acceptance.

visual_review.lighting_change: Smaller ceiling light pools and darker interior; path and pedestrians remain visible.
visual_review.remaining: Bright fixture lenses, thin-looking portal edges, generic surrounding buildings and abrupt ground transitions still need art work.
